## NOC — Command Center (`noc-command-center`, folder noc)

NOC wallboard for any set of routers, switches and firewalls: choose Device Type and any number of Devices at the top (kept in the URL). Everything is read from Zabbix — host groups, hosts, item tags and names; nothing is hardcoded.

Tags: noc, netops, command-center. Variables: `devtype`, `device`.

| Panel | Type |
|---|---|
| Selected devices | stat |
| UP | stat |
| DOWN | stat |
| UNKNOWN | stat |
| High / Disaster problems | stat |
| Fleet health — selected devices | table |
| Active problems — selected devices | alexanderzobnin-zabbix-triggers-panel |
| CPU utilization — top 10 of the selected devices | timeseries |
| Memory utilization — top 10 of the selected devices | timeseries |

## NOC — Device Health (`noc-device-health`, folder noc)

Any router, switch or firewall monitored by Zabbix: choose Device Type, Device and Interfaces at the top. Hosts, interfaces and metrics are read from Zabbix (host groups, interface discovery tags, item tags and names) — nothing is hardcoded.

Tags: noc, netops, device-health. Variables: `devtype`, `device`, `interface`.

| Panel | Type |
|---|---|
| Reachability (ICMP) | stat |
| SNMP availability | stat |
| ICMP response time | stat |
| ICMP loss | stat |
| Uptime | stat |
| CPU now | stat |
| CPU utilization | timeseries |
| Memory now | stat |
| Memory utilization | timeseries |
| Interface status | table |
| Interface traffic (bits/s) | timeseries |
| Interface errors and discards | timeseries |

## NOC — Network Traffic (`noc-network-traffic`, folder noc)

Interface traffic wallboard for any routers, switches and firewalls: choose Device Type, Devices and Interfaces at the top (kept in the URL). Inbound/outbound traffic, utilization, interface status, errors and discards — all read from Zabbix (host groups, interface discovery tags, item names); nothing is hardcoded.

Tags: noc, netops, traffic. Variables: `devtype`, `device`, `interface`.

| Panel | Type |
|---|---|
| Total inbound | stat |
| Total outbound | stat |
| Interfaces | stat |
| Interfaces UP | stat |
| Interfaces DOWN | stat |
| Total traffic — inbound and outbound | timeseries |
| Top 10 busiest interface directions | bargauge |
| Top 10 utilization — inbound | bargauge |
| Top 10 utilization — outbound | bargauge |
| Inbound by interface — top 10 | timeseries |
| Outbound by interface — top 10 | timeseries |
| Errors and discards — top 10 | timeseries |
| Interfaces DOWN — selected | table |
| Interfaces — detail | table |
